name: Futa Island: Last Man Filming
source:
You came to film a reality show. The hiring bot made you a contestant.

You applied to be the camera guy on a trashy reality show. The production's hiring bot filed you as a contestant instead, and by the time anyone noticed, you'd signed a 200-page contract with a $2,000,000 penalty for leaving early.

Now you're on a tropical island with a welcome daiquiri, introduced as this season's twist. Five contestants, one villa, and cameras everywhere.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5288480/Futa_Island_Last_Man_Filming/]Steam[/url]]
